authority: This is the authoritative source for install/update channels. The `source` field in toolchain.ps1 / inventory.json may be stale and MUST NOT be used to decide how a tool is updated. Never update a tool through a channel other than the one recorded here. Detection (check) is safe; actual upgrades require explicit user approval.

winget.description: Installed and updated by Windows Package Manager. Use only the recorded package ID.

npm.description: Installed via npm (registry mirror https://registry.npmmirror.com/). npm itself self-updates; other packages are global npm installs.

uv.description: uv-managed CPython or uv-installed tool. Never use global python/pip.
uv.check: uv python list --all-versions | uv tool list
uv.upgrade: uv python upgrade <minor> | uv tool upgrade --all

uvx.description: Ephemeral tool run via uvx; always resolves the latest release, no persistent install.

npx.description: Ephemeral tool run via npx.cmd from the npmmirror registry.
npx.upgrade: npx.cmd -y <tool> update (or reinstall with a new source)

remote-oauth.description: Hosted remote MCP registration in an agent config; authenticated by the provider's OAuth flow, not by a local package manager.
remote-oauth.upgrade: Managed by the remote provider; re-authenticate with `opencode mcp auth <name>` if needed

dotnet-tool.check: dotnet tool list --global / dotnet tool update --global <package> --check

jetbrains-toolbox.description: Android Studio is installed and auto-updated by JetBrains Toolbox, not by winget or a standalone installer.
jetbrains-toolbox.upgrade: Use JetBrains Toolbox UI; do not overwrite with winget

android-studio.description: Android SDK components are updated through Android Studio (SDK Manager / android sdk), not by a package manager.
android-studio.upgrade: Use Android Studio UI, not a package manager

visual-studio-installer.description: Visual Studio and its bundled MSVC/MSBuild/CMake/Ninja ship with the VS installer.
visual-studio-installer.upgrade: Use Visual Studio Installer, not a package manager

manual-fixed.description: Manually downloaded ZIP/JAR/installer, often pinned by REA. Do not auto-upgrade; version drift can break REA path mappings.
manual-fixed.upgrade: Manual download only, with explicit approval

built-in.description: OS/tool built-in component; updated with the OS or its parent product.
